Anakbuah membaca kalender untuk menemukan bentrok jadwal dan hal penting yang perlu kamu perhatikan.

With Always, Dash can help at the right moment, like telling you when to leave or reminding you about a return when you’re near the store. Your location history stays on this iPhone; Dash only receives moments like “arrived home.”
Dash uses your location when you choose to attach it to a conversation or set your home city, so it can help with nearby places, weather, and travel.
Dash uses your camera when you choose to take a photo to attach to a conversation. Photos are not saved to your photo library.
Dash saves photos from your conversations when you tap the download button.
Dash uses your microphone only when you choose to dictate a task or instruction.
LaunchBackground
Editor
Dash reads and updates reminders when you connect Reminders in Settings and ask for help with your tasks.
Dash finds and updates people you allow when you connect Contacts in Settings.
Dash reads the photos you allow and organizes albums when you connect Photos in Settings.
Dash reads the health data you choose to answer your sleep, hydration and fitness questions. Sharing with Dash for an answer requires your confirmation.
Dash saves water intake to Health when you ask and approve the entry.
Dash reads your accessories and runs the home actions you approve after you connect Apple Home in Settings.
Dash searches your library, creates playlists and plays music when you connect Apple Music in Settings.
Dash reads recent steps and activity for your fitness questions after you connect Motion in Settings.
Dash schedules alarms and timers you request and approve after connecting Alarms in Settings.
